english.note: Use this as the all-purpose rendering for physical or abstract containment and location.

exampleSentences.english: The book is in the bag.
exampleSentences.jyutping: bun2 syu1 hai2 go3 doi6 jap6 min6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something located within a container, room, or area.

exampleSentences.english: The ball is inside the box.
exampleSentences.jyutping: go3 bo1 hai2 go3 soeng1 jap6 min6

english.note: For physical location, this is the all-purpose everyday way to say that something is inside A.

exampleSentences.english: I’m looking for my book within the room.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我喺間房入面搵緊本書。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 gaan1 fong2 jap6 min6 wan2 gan2 bun2 syu1
